name: Octree Node Decoder
definition: A recursive decoder applied to octree nodes to transform 4D feature vectors back to explicit binary occupancy voxel grids or intermediate features, distinguishing between interior nodes and leaf nodes.
summary: The Octree Node Decoder is a recursive neural network that transforms 4D feature vectors into explicit voxel grids, distinguishing interior nodes that propagate features from leaf nodes that resolve spatial voxels.
